items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And so was Phil Harris, a very dear friend.

ctx.x: Yeah. I used Johnny when I had charge of the Studebaker transcriptions. When him was in San Francisco, I came back to New York and had charge of the... I had the guy that wrote Tenderly and played piano. I had... I didn't have an author. I had Chris Griffin, who was with Goodman. And I don't remember the whole gang of it. These guys were fantastic musicians. Ray Block was a conductor. It sounds silly, but I mean, it's all true. And I enjoyed these things. And I worked with a lot of great musicians. And being in…
when I was going to leave Pete.
